Brewmaster Amber 5.4%
Light on the bitterness for an amber. It’s good but kind of misses the point of what an amber should be and is almost at the lager level 6/10  Had this at Bot Craft Beer in Da Nang. Seemed like a brand new place with a nice beer garden and 4 craft beer taps.

#🍺 #craftbeer #vietnam #amberale
